nieuw.titel: Use marching column to escape an enemy charge arc
nieuw.tekst: Consider changing into marching column to move a unit's footprint outside an enemy's charge arc instead of relying on a march test.
nieuw.waarom: He feared that failing the march test would leave him unable to manoeuvre at a pivotal moment.
nieuw.voorbeeld: He changed the Sisters into marching column, leaving them just outside the Griffon BSB's charge arc. The Griffon went elsewhere the following turn, and the Sisters survived to the end of the game.
